newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore sending trade mission to Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Singapore sending trade mission to Latin America.

text.p: Singapore will send a 14-strong trade delegation to Brazil, Chile and Argentina from April 13-27 to expand economic links with its fastest growing trading partners, the government said on Thursday.

"As one of Singapore's fastest growing regional trading partners, Latin America's linkage with Singapore is expected to increase in the coming years," the Trade Development Board (TDB) said in a statement.
Singapore's exports to the region in 1996 rose 23 percent to Singapore $2.6 billion (US$1.8 billion) while its imports from the area expanded 27 percent to reach S$1.8 billion last year.
"Our aim in this mission is to explore the scope for trade cooperation and bilateral trade expansion in these newer and lesser known markets," EDB chief Barry Desker said in the statement.
Most of the members of the delegation are involved in the food and beverage, textile, timber and consumer products.
